title: LeeTKOB checker prediction line, version 1
description: One JSONL line written by `checker --data <dir> --predictions <file>`. Predictions derive only from statements, constraints and source; never labels or scorer data. `MODEL_OFF=1` decides ban-list pairs with hard rules and writes unsure for every semantic pair.

solution.description: Solution identifier from the dataset directory, not a per-problem configured value.

constraint.description: Constraint identifier as discovered from the dataset.

line.description: One-based line in the solution source.

evidence.description: Original-line evidence; required by the schema even when empty, so an unsure line is always valid JSONL.
